upset.en: He wasn't a nice man. He was cunning, lazy, greedy, and easily upset.
upset.zh: 他不是个好人。他狡猾、懒惰、贪婪，而且很容易暴躁。

upset.en: But for while, she was seeing things online about Betsy DeVos that upset her.
upset.zh: 但有一段时间，她在网上看到了一些关于Betsy DeVos的负面消息，这让她很难过。

upset.en: I think seeing how upset the students were, they were then calling for a different outcome.
upset.zh: 我想，看到学生们如此激动，他们随即也开始呼吁一个不同的结果。

upset.en: I just remember she hit the button and I just wasn't that upset.
upset.zh: 我只记得她按下了那个按钮，而我居然没有那么生气。

upset.en: Yes, and a nightmare is a very scary or upsetting dream.
upset.zh: 是的，噩梦（nightmare）是一个非常可怕或令人沮丧的梦。

upon.en: So they sailed across the Atlantic, dreaming of a holy community, a shining “city upon a hill”.
upon.zh: 于是他们扬帆起航跨越大西洋，怀揣着建立一个圣洁社群、打造一座闪耀的“山巅之城”的梦想。

upon.en: It protected the established Church of England and, by extension, the political order that rested upon it.
upon.zh: 它保护了既定的英格兰教会，并由此延伸，保护了赖以建立的政治秩序。

upon.en: Well, there are some things that our experts all agree upon.
upon.zh: 嗯，有些事情是我们的专家都一致同意的。

upon.en: And something which is described as the go-to can be relied upon as the best thing for a particular situation.
upon.zh: 被描述为 go-to 的东西可以被视为特定情况下最可靠、最好的选择。

upon.en: You can use the phrase go-to to describe something which is relied upon to be the best thing for a particular purpose.
upon.zh: 你可以使用 go-to 这个短语来描述为了特定目的而被认为最可靠、最好的东西。

upwards.en: …which was the right answer. Yay! Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with roll your eyes – to move your eyes upwards to show you are bored or annoyed.
upwards.zh: ……这就是正确的答案。太棒了！让我们回顾一下学到的词汇，从“翻白眼”开始——向上转动眼睛以表现出你感到无聊或恼火。

upwards.en: During the first thirty years or so of space launches, it would typically cost in the region of $25,000 per kilo to send something to space, but some projects were upwards of $100,000 per kilo.
upwards.zh: 在太空发射的前三十年左右，把东西送上太空通常花费大约每公斤 25,000 美元，有些项目甚至超过每公斤 100,000 美元。

update.en: One reason for not updating tech is if the original design still works well.
update.zh: 不更新科技的一个原因，是最初的设计依然运行良好。

update.en: Speaking of updating beliefs, is there anything that you've changed your mind around recently?
update.zh: 说到更新信念，你最近有没有改变主意的事情？

update.en: If it’s constantly changing and updating, is it still the same robot?
update.zh: 如果它在不断变化和更新，它还是同一个机器人吗？

update.en: If there's anything that's front of mind where you go, ah, yeah, that's a pretty big OS update.
update.zh: 如果有什么是你想到的，你会说，‘啊，是的，那是一个相当大的操作系统更新。’

update.en: And today’s episode is an update to that original one.
update.zh: 而今天的节目是对当年那期内容的更新。

upright.en: That name, as the Latin scholars among you will know, simply means upright human.
upright.zh: 正如你们当中的拉丁语学者所知，这个名字的意思很简单，就是直立的人。

upright.en: Another argues that they were walked upright using ropes, rocking them forward step by step.
upright.zh: 另一种观点则认为，它们是利用绳索直立“行走”的，通过一步步左右摇晃向前移动。

upright.en: Their teeth became smaller. Their ears, which were previously sharp and upright to catch the sound of prey, began to flop over.
upright.zh: 它们的牙齿变小了。它们的耳朵原本是为了捕捉猎物声音而竖立着的尖耳，现在开始耷拉下来。

upgrade.en: So, in 1541, Henry VIII declared himself King of Ireland, an upgrade from the previous title of Lord.
upgrade.zh: 于是，在 1541 年，Henry VIII 宣布自己为爱尔兰国王，这是对他之前“领主”头衔的升级。

upgrade.en: Imagine a robot that slowly upgrades over time.
upgrade.zh: 想象一个随着时间慢慢升级的机器人。

upgrade.en: Think about a smartphone. Over time, you might replace the screen as it cracks, upgrade the battery, add a new case, or even change the internal parts.
upgrade.zh: 想想智能手机。随着时间的推移，你可能会在屏幕破裂时更换它、升级电池、添加新外壳，甚至更换内部零件。

upgrade.en: And so like, in that way, it's acceptance, but of like your, your idea of who I am that you hate so much i accept it i can live with that even though like we don't want to think what if i am it i don't believe that but i can do that and i can end the conversation so i'm taking improv classes at the moment because i'm doing my first live shows in the uk and island oh so this live talk uh thank you yeah uh everything's uh no solo stood on stage for 90 minutes comedy no just oh okay lessons yeah insights and stuff probably some shit that i've learned today uh anyway we released it and every show sold out and then got venue upgraded and then sold out again in less than 45 minutes across all of the dates which was great but then scary because i now had to speak to like three times as many people per night for additional nights on top of what i thought anyway i'm doing improv in improv there is one rule and the rule is don't punk the game so uh we're doing some exercise where we need to make silly noises as we pass this imaginary energy around and i need to go like boing and send it back and you need to go whoosh and pass it on and all this sort of shit the one thing that you're not allowed to do is not make one of the noises that's allowed yeah and i really think about punking the game an awful lot and you see it happen in podcasts you see it happen on tv you see it happen and it can be both destructive and constructive, but it's always destructive to the people that are trying to play the game.
upgrade.zh: 所以，从某种意义上说，这是一种接受，接受你对我那种充满恨意的看法。我接受它，我可以忍受，尽管我们不想去想“万一我是呢”，我不相信那是真的，但我可以那样做，我可以结束对话。

uproar.en: But one consequence of the protests and this uproar matters directly for the history of blasphemy law.
uproar.zh: 但抗议和这场喧嚣的一个后果直接关系到亵渎法的发展史。

upper.en: And what had once been a luxury of the Victorian upper classes became a global norm.
upper.zh: 曾经属于维多利亚时代上流社会的奢侈品，变成了全球的常态。

upper.en: It takes up three modified apartments on the Upper East Side of Manhattan.
upper.zh: 它占据了曼哈顿上东区三套改造过的公寓。

upper.en: So basically an increase from intermediate English to upper intermediate.
upper.zh: 所以基本上是从中级英语提高到中高级。

upper.en: The following year, I tried to do the same, but this time I entered the upper intermediate level of the speech contest.
upper.zh: 第二年，我试图再次挑战，但这次我参加的是演讲比赛的中高级组。

upper.en: What is clear is that there had been various groups within the Nazi upper leadership that had been planning to overthrow or kill Hitler since before the start of the war.
upper.zh: 但明确的是，早在战争爆发之前，纳粹高层领导层内部就一直有各种团体在策划推翻或杀死希特勒。

upward.en: It’s linked to the idea of upward social mobility.
upward.zh: 它与纵向社会流动的概念紧密相连。

uphold.en: It was created after World War II to protect peace, solve conflicts, and uphold international law.
uphold.zh: 它创立于二战之后，旨在维护和平、解决冲突并捍卫国际法。

upstairs.en: I'm like, see, you can feel the heat coming off of me as I go upstairs.
upstairs.zh: 我说，你看，当我上楼时，你能感觉到我身上散发出的热气。
